meta.transit_stress: betweenness centrality (unweighted) on the 471-node/587-edge Seoul subway graph (kr_stations + network.geojson), min-max normalized 0-100, quintile tier (very-low..very-high = least..most transit-critical/congested).
meta.walk_stress: HONEST PROXY, coordinates only: station_density_800m = count of OTHER stations within 800m great-circle distance. walk_stress_score = 100 - minmax(density). Fewer nearby stations -> higher walk stress (fewer walkable alternates). NOT based on sidewalks/terrain/pedestrian network. INTERNAL-ONLY since huntdata-0808 (H10): 249/471 stations tie at exactly 100.0 (zero neighbors within 800m), collapsing quintile tiers — the per-station value is not displayable and is NO LONGER copied into stations.geojson / content.json. It still feeds the walk_ease_mean AREA aggregates (district/dong composites), where averaging over members retains real variation.
